died.name: Élisabeth of France
died.cause: when her fichu fell from her neck prior to her execution by guillotine
died.last_words: I pray you, gentlemen, in the name of modesty, suffer me to cover my bosom.

died.name: Theodore Parker
died.desc: American transcendentalist, Unitarian minister and abolitionist
died.cause: referring to notables who would attend his funeral
died.last_words: It is all one, Phillips and Clarke will come for my sake.

died.name: Stonewall Jackson
died.desc: American and Confederate soldier and general of the American Civil War
died.cause: dying of pneumonia after being wounded by friendly fire
died.last_words: Order A.P. Hill to prepare for action! Pass the infantry to the front rapidly! Tell Major Hawks.... Let us cross over the river and rest under the shade of the trees.

died.name: Raymond Hamilton
died.cause: before dying in the electric chair

died.name: John Wayne Gacy
died.desc: American serial killer and sex offender
died.cause: prior to execution by lethal injection

born.name: Charles de Bonchamps
born.desc: French politician and leader of the Royalist Vendéan insurrection
born.cause: mortally wounded at the Second Battle of Cholet. He was ordering the pardon of five thousand Republican prisoners whom his troops intended to kill
born.last_words: Pardon for the prisoners, Bonchamps commands it!

born.name: John Wilkes Booth
born.desc: American actor and assassin of Abraham Lincoln
born.cause: after being fatally shot by Boston Corbett
born.last_words: Tell mother, tell mother, I died for my country...useless...useless...

born.name: Karl Barth
born.cause: over the telephone to his friend Eduard Thurneysen
born.last_words: God sits in the regiments! That is why I am not afraid. Stay confident in also the darkest moments! Let us hope not fall, the hope for all people, for all the peoples of the world. God let us not fall, not a single one of us and all of us together. It is governed.

born.name: Alfred Jodl
born.cause: prior to his execution by hanging for war crimes and crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)
born.last_words: My greetings to you, my Germany.

born.name: Alfonso, Prince of Asturias
born.desc: former heir apparent to the throne of Spain
born.cause: dying of internal bleeding after car accident in Miami, Florida
born.last_words: ¡Mi madre! ¡Mi madre! Where is my mother? I'm all alone in this country. Don't leave me, Jack.
